anchors.invariant: Why first. Self-serve name-claim cannot mark a mini-app today; SSH publish is the only path.
Living mini-app contract already defines app=v1 / path= and consumer re-validation.
v1 name-claim preimage is challenge+name+port only; ip and scheme are already unsigned extras.
Shelf already rejects path without leading slash, with //, backslash, controls, or a scheme.

acceptance.if_true: A worker can add the unsigned app marker on name-claim and the CLI without changing the signed preimage, and cannot persist an invalid path or a second signing scheme.
acceptance.if_false: The marker is inside the v1 signature, a bad path can overwrite a lease, or publish-time checks become the security boundary instead of consumer re-validation.
